collector_id.description: Target specific route collector for latest data. Examples: 'route-views.linx', 'rrc01'. Omit to get latest files from all collectors.

data_type.description: Type of latest BGP data needed. 'rib' returns most recent routing table snapshots (best for current network topology analysis), 'updates' returns latest real-time routing changes (best for monitoring recent network events). Omit to get both types.
